name: Investigate Vega (vegaml) for chat board/column organization
description: Design proposal for a Vega-based chat router (board + column + priority) with calibrated confidence and abstain-based fallback to a review column.

messages.content:
Design proposal for a Vega-based chat router (board + column + priority) with calibrated confidence and abstain-based fallback to a review column.
Investigate using vegaml (https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/vegaml) to organize codx-api chats into boards and columns.

Findings: Vega answers closed-set typed questions (choice/score/boolean) with calibrated probabilities and an abstain flag, from one frozen-LM + physics-engine pass, no text generation and no JSON parsing. This matches the board+column routing problem better than the current free-form LLM JSON approach.

Deliverable: docs/vega-chat-organization.md (design proposal).

Open questions: where Chat.auto_initialize is consumed; exact kanban.json schema; reconcile model.model.Board/Column vs db.Kanban/KanbanColumn; in-process vs vegaml-serve deployment.
